reason_explanations.commit_failed: COMMIT reported failure and did not change the active image.
reason_explanations.commit_mismatch: Successful COMMIT named a different slot or digest from its pending transaction.
reason_explanations.commit_unverified: Successful COMMIT matches its pending transaction, but that transaction does not have a verified flag.
reason_explanations.commit_without_stage: Successful COMMIT has no pending transaction. Under R3, boot epoch advances clear all pending transactions before processing the event.
reason_explanations.duplicate_conflict: The event ID has different normalized payloads. All rows for this ID are excluded from reconciliation; the incident uses its minimum location.
reason_explanations.reset_failed: RESET reported failure and did not itself clear pending transactions. Any boot epoch advance clears pending state before processing the action.
reason_explanations.rollback_failed: ROLLBACK reported failure and did not change the active image.
reason_explanations.rollback_unverified: Successful ROLLBACK named an exact slot and digest pair absent from this board's verified image history. A matching digest previously verified on another slot does not authorize this rollback. Verified image history survives boot epoch advances.
reason_explanations.stage_failed: STAGE reported failure and left pending transactions unchanged after any boot epoch advance.
reason_explanations.verify_failed: VERIFY reported failure. Under R3, an earlier verified flag on its pending transaction is cleared; verified image history is retained.
reason_explanations.verify_mismatch: Successful VERIFY named a different slot or digest from its pending transaction and cleared that transaction's verified flag.
reason_explanations.verify_without_stage: VERIFY has no pending transaction to verify. Under R3, boot epoch advances clear all pending transactions before processing the event.
